comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained; terms are standard domain vocabulary.

feasibility.reason: Implementable with known automotive technology; contradicts nothing stated.

parent_fit.reason: Specifies the start condition of the charging session that ARCH_CHG_SESSION_CONTROL runs (a distinct part of the session control).

unambiguity.reason: One reading; 'CCS inlet' is product-neutral across CCS1/CCS2.

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in subsystems/chg (bev-only folder); every alternative of the parent is also inside bev and the market/inlet alternatives are exhaustive (Kconfig: region eu|na; mcs needs v800 needs bev), so the need never exists without a parent.

verifiability.reason: Test: unlocked inlet -> no session start; locked -> session may start.
